dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical convex narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Off-white to light-grey median intensity, consistent with a near-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse dark-pixel clusters concentrated in the posterior-right and anterior-median regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slope between residual pigmented areas and the primary off-white surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct vertical linear high-contrast mark located on the posterior-right dorsal quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A single elongated linear scar or rake mark is visible on the right side of the posterior dorsal area.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, dark circular blowhole at the anterior end of the visible dorsal plane.
